tools.description: How to use the night-out planner: the largest places, supported vibes, and the rules to follow when relaying a plan (validated venues only, no invented details, legal drinking age). Read-only and free.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "drinkedin_plan_night_out" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
